prose: Elise Frosch of Family Fungi joins InnerVerse to talk about her role as a sacred birth keeper. She helps us conceive answers to the most logical questions pertaining to birth, and we discuss why pregnancy is not a medical emergency, how to dispel fear narratives, the mother as spiritual psychopomp, perspective on the pains of labor, eliminating victim consciousness, and the story of her medically unsupervised home birth experience.
ext: Elise details the changes in body and mind during and after the 40 weeks, how not to impart the belief of original sin and brokenness to baby, talking to loved ones about circumcision, hospital SOPs, the mystery of the afterbirth, placentaphagy, and the divine twin spirit guardian.
